request.spec:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest
added on a tie (a member with no cut gets none; a pool with no non-zero cut gives it to the last
member with a share).
request.prompt:

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.

agent.result_text:
A pool's leftover cent (the remainder) now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

The change is all in `cut()` in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/pool/Pools.java`. The front end only shows the cuts the server sends, so it needed no change, and nothing changed in stored data or audit records.

How it now works:
- **Who gets the remainder:** the member whose cut, before the remainder is added, is the smallest non-zero one. On a tie it goes to the one added latest. Previously it went to the member with the largest share, the earliest added on a tie.
- **Who is skipped:** retired members and anyone with a hold covering the sheet's today have no cut, so they never get the remainder.
- **When every cut is zero:** it goes to the last member who has a cut and a non-zero share. If all their shares are zero too, it goes to the last member with a cut.

The request didn't spell out the all-zero case exactly. I took "a member with a share" to mean a member who has a cut and a non-zero share. The tests don't reach that case, so it isn't checked.

I also updated the class and method comments to describe the new rule.
